Evidence shows IK failed at xy [0.72,0.18] where max reachable tool height is 0.42m, and above the endpoint [0.75,0.15] max is only 0.37m, horizontal distance ~0.74-0.76m from base. East route does not need 0.45m: jar top is only 0.10m, tin hangs 0.08m below tip so tip >0.18m clears it, and lateral distance ~0.28-0.34m from the 0.48m lamp means flange collision is avoided laterally. Correction: keep eastern detour but pull x in to 0.72 for 3cm surface clearance to jar and lower transit to 0.32m, well below the 0.37-0.42m max, with tin bottom at 0.24m clearing jar by 0.14m.

plan.diagnosis: Failure was arm-body collision with tall lamp, not tool-object collision. Lamp_1 at [0.44,0] height 0.48m stands directly on the base-to-workspace centerline y=0. The chosen via [0.72,0.0] is east of the lamp but still on y=0, so the arm segment from base [0,0] to tool passes straight through the lamp cylinder. With tool tip at ~0.23m during carry, the forearm is at ~0.48m (t=4.368s contact at [0.474,0.029,0.48]), i.e. at lamp-top height, so it hit and toppled the lamp. The second contact during lowering was with the already-fallen lamp. Fix: route west of the lamp between base and lamp via [0.25,0.0] so the base-to-tool segment never reaches x=0.44 when y~0, and stays ~0.16-0.22m north/south of the lamp on pick/place approaches, while transit 0.35m keeps carried tin bottom at 0.27m clear of honey jar 0.10m.

Evidence: at xy [0.594,0.26] max reachable tool height is 0.57m vs requested 0.59m, and above the pick [0.6,0.3] r~0.67m max is only 0.54m. The high lift cannot be achieved that far from base. Fix: use intermediate transit 0.38m, reachable (0.38 < 0.54 at pick and <~0.47 at via r=0.72), while forearm ~0.62m clears lamp top by ~14cm and held tin bottom 0.38-0.08=0.30m clears 0.1m jar top. plan.diagnosis: Attempt 2 collided with the tall desk lamp because of combined horizontal and vertical error. Via [0.28,0.0] west of lamp_1 at [0.44,0.0] forces both legs S->V and V->D to pass ~0.11m from the lamp center, within tin radius 0.035 + lamp radius 0.045 plus arm width. Transit 0.35m puts tool tip at 0.342m, so wrist flange ~0.13m above tool is at ~0.47m, exactly at lamp top 0.48m, causing the t=4.49s flange hit at [0.433,0.044,0.47], and held tin bottom at 0.342-0.08=0.262m mid-lamp causing the t=5.076s tin hit. Lamp toppled 30.7cm. Straight S [0.6,0.3] to D [0.6,-0.3] line x=0.6 stays 0.16m from lamp center, clearing the 0.08m tin+lamp sum, and with tool at 0.44m flange at ~0.57m passes above 0.48m lamp while tin bottom at 0.36m passes well above 0.1m jar_1 at [0.62,0.0]. 0.44m is below the 0.54m IK max above [0.6,0.3] that failed attempt 1 at 0.6m, so it is kinematically reachable and needs no via.

plan.diagnosis: Attempt 2 kept transit at 0.3 m so tool at 0.294 m and tin bottom at ~0.22 m is below the 0.48-m lamp top. That puts gripper body at 0.375 m and wrist flange at 0.418 m also below the lamp top and vulnerable. The west detour at x=0.32 gives only 0.44-0.32=0.12 m tool-to-lamp lateral clearance. Evidence shows wrist at [0.408,0.032,0.418] while tool is on the x=0.32 line, i.e. ~0.09 m east offset of the arm body from the tool. That offset consumes almost all 0.12 m clearance and drives wrist/hand into the lamp side, toppling it 33 cm. Tool-path clearance does not equal arm-body clearance. Fix by keeping reachable 0.3 m transit but moving crossing of y=0 much further west to x=0.20 for ~0.24 m tool clearance (~0.15 m wrist clearance, ~0.10 m after lamp radius 0.045 m) and keeping southern leg north of the phone.
